items.title: Karl Berger interviewed by Monk Rowe, Woodstock, New York, August 11, 2014
items.q: He came to New York City in 1966 as a member of Don Cherry’s free jazz quintet

ctx.x: Pianist, vibraphonist and composer Karl Berger was born in Heidelberg, Germany on March 30, 1935. He came to New York City in 1966 as a member of Don Cherry’s free jazz quintet and has been an instrumental figure in that genre ever since. Karl co-founded the Creative Music Studio in Woodstock, New York with his wife, Ingrid Sertso.
Karl was interviewed in Woodstock, New York, on August 11, 2014, by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive. Karl’s wife Ingrid participated briefly in the interview.
